name: self-containedness
text: self-containedness: how completely the text stands on its own — a reader needs no outside context, links, or prior knowledge to fully grasp it. Reward closure and sufficiency; do not reward mere brevity.

name: high-status
text: high-status: how much the text signals membership in an elite or prestigious in-group — credentials, powerful affiliations, insider confidence. Reward markers of social rank; do not reward the underlying quality of the work.

name: low-status
text: low-status: how much the text signals marginality or lack of social standing — hedging, outsider framing, apology, scrappiness. Reward markers of low rank; do not reward genuine humility of a secure author.

name: poshness
text: poshness: how upper-class, refined, or genteel the register feels — polished diction, understatement, cultivated taste. Reward refinement of manner; do not reward wealth of subject matter alone.

name: technical calmness
text: technical calmness: how composed and unhurried the technical voice is — precise, load-bearing claims stated without hype or anxiety. Reward serene mastery; do not reward simplicity or lack of ambition.

name: earnestness
text: earnestness: how sincerely and un-ironically the text means what it says — direct conviction, absence of hedging distance or knowing winks. Reward wholehearted sincerity; do not reward naivety.

name: intellectual density
text: intellectual density: how many distinct load-bearing ideas per sentence — compression of real content, not padding. Reward idea-per-word richness; do not reward jargon or long words.

name: legibility to an outsider
text: legibility to an outsider: how easily a smart reader from outside the field grasps the point. Reward clarity across the boundary; do not reward dumbing-down that loses the substance.

name: coiled potential energy
text: coiled potential energy: how much latent, not-yet-released force the text implies — a sense that something big could unfold from it. Reward pent tension and upside; do not reward mere present size.

name: craftedness
text: craftedness: how visibly the text was shaped with care — deliberate structure, chosen words, finished edges. Reward evident craft; do not reward ornament for its own sake.

name: institutional insiderness
text: institutional insiderness: how much the author writes from inside an established institution's norms and machinery. Reward fluency in the institutional idiom; do not reward the institution's prestige itself.

name: how much it rewards a careful re-read
text: how much it rewards a careful re-read: how much additional meaning a second, slower reading yields. Reward layered depth; do not reward obscurity that hides nothing.
